Project Memory — gtfs2emis

Source: MEMORY.md

Corrections and learned facts that persist across sessions (local only; gitignored). When a mistake is corrected, append a [LEARN:category] wrong → right entry below. Suggested categories: ef, units, data.table, parallel, data, api, tests, cran, docs, perf, workflow, tooling.

Workflow

[LEARN:workflow] Workflow config was ported from gtfs2gps (2026-10-12) → gtfs2gps-only items (Rcpp/src, gtfs2gps() worker path, poa/saopaulo fixtures, GPS column types) do NOT apply here. gtfs2emis is pure R, uses cli for conditions since 2026-10-13 (conventions A4), test_ files, master, and tests are Rbuildignored (not run on CRAN).

[LEARN:workflow] Grep tool skips gitignored files → search .claude/ (gitignored here) with shell grep -r.

[LEARN:tooling] (inherited, same machine) git-guardrails matches command TEXT, so a heredoc that merely mentions a destructive git command gets blocked → write helper scripts with the Write tool, then run them.

[LEARN:tooling] (inherited) Avoid > inside Rscript -e '...' strings on Windows: it was treated as a redirect and created a stray file.

[LEARN:tooling] (inherited) devtools::document() with roxygen2 8 replaces RoxygenNote: with Config/roxygen2/version: in DESCRIPTION → restore the RoxygenNote line unless the maintainers agree to move; and use devtools::check(document = FALSE, ...).

[LEARN:tooling] (inherited) Rewriting a whole R file with the Write tool strips trailing whitespace on untouched lines (noisy diff) → use Edit for small changes.

[LEARN:parallel] (inherited from gtfs2gps) Under load_all(), furrr multisession workers load the installed package → devtools::install(quick = TRUE, upgrade = FALSE) before testing a changed worker path in transport_model()/emission_model().

[LEARN:tooling] (inherited) gh CLI is not installed on this machine → PRs are opened by the user from the GitHub compare URL; prepare the body in a file.

[LEARN:tooling] (inherited) sed/perl replacement strings containing \c on Git Bash turn \code{ into a control byte → write roxygen text with Write/Edit, never via shell replacement strings.

[LEARN:workflow] (inherited) Subagents cannot write report files → the orchestrator saves each hand-back to disk itself.

[LEARN:workflow] (inherited) Concurrent agents must not devtools::load_all()/install into the same library at once → install once to an isolated lib (R CMD INSTALL -l <scratch>/lib .) and load with library(gtfs2emis, lib.loc = ...).

[LEARN:tooling] (inherited) git add can fail with “unable to write new index file” (Dropbox briefly locking .git) → check for .git/*.lock, then retry.

[LEARN:api] Assumed gtfs2emis keeps base stop()/message() → maintainer decided 2026-10-13 to route all conditions through cli. checkmate stays for the checks via internal assert_*() wrappers in R/conditions.R (conventions A4).

[LEARN:tooling] The Write tool strips whitespace-only lines inside strings in scratch scripts, so exact-match replacements of R code that contains a blank-but-indented line fail → delete or normalise that line first (sed), or match with a regex.
